## Summary

- Enable planner-backed initial PR `/orchestrate` starts in `agent` mode while preserving deterministic PR routing in `heuristics` mode.
- Validate planner-selected PR routes so open PR starts can dispatch only `review` or `fix-pr`, while `answer`, `stop`, and `blocked` produce visible no-dispatch outcomes.
- Update orchestrator prompt/docs and add focused tests for preflight, policy validation, PR dispatch, closed PR stops, and planner answer handling.

## Verification

- `npm run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/handoff.test.js`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/orchestrator-preflight-cli.test.js`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/orchestrate-handoff-cli.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #187

comments.body:
No, I don’t think it’s too complicated. It’s more complex than the regex heuristic in #181, but it puts the complexity in the right place: model intent parsing plus deterministic policy gates.

Why it feels reasonable:

- `heuristics` mode stays simple and deterministic: PRs still route by status to `review` or `fix-pr`.
- `agent` mode now does what we wanted: planner-backed PR `/orchestrate` can choose `review`, `fix-pr`, `answer`, `stop`, or `blocked`.
- The write-capable routes are still gated in code: PR planner starts can only dispatch `review` or `fix-pr`, and closed PRs stop before dispatch.
- Most of the added size is tests/docs, especially for `fix-pr`, `review`, closed PR stop, and answer-without-dispatch behavior.

Key pieces:
- Planner PR path: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/ed0df2bee677790c90a0dbedb9759981faa922ff/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L1310-L1353
- PR route validation: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/ed0df2bee677790c90a0dbedb9759981faa922ff/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L558-L573
- `answer` handling: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/ed0df2bee677790c90a0dbedb9759981faa922ff/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L487-L497
- Regression tests: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/ed0df2bee677790c90a0dbedb9759981faa922ff/.agent/src/__tests__/orchestrate-handoff-cli.test.ts#L868-L960

My only caution: if `decideAgentHandoff()` keeps accumulating route-specific cases, we should split PR-start validation into a helper. But for this PR, the scope is coherent and the `check` job is passing.

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #188 implements #187 by making agent-mode PR `/orchestrate` starts planner-backed instead of purely deterministic.
- The planner can select `review`, `fix-pr`, `answer`, `stop`, or `blocked`, while runtime policy keeps PR starts limited to `review` and `fix-pr` dispatches.
- The change also updates prompts/docs and adds focused tests for PR planner routing, closed PR stops, and answer handling.
- This is the right direction, but one dispatch-context gap can send write-capable `fix-pr` automation after the wrong task.

## Review
The design is mostly coherent and preserves the important route-policy gates, but the planner-selected PR `fix-pr` path needs a guard before this can ship. There is also one stale technical-doc paragraph that contradicts the new behavior.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Planner-selected PR fix-pr can fall back to wrong task context | BLOCKING | A PR planner `fix-pr` handoff can omit `handoff_context`; the CLI then supplies the manual `CHANGES_REQUESTED` fallback even for planner-parsed tasks like fixing CI or merge conflicts. |
| Technical docs still say PR agent starts are deterministic | WARNING | A later paragraph in the orchestrator technical docs still says manual PR starts remain deterministic in `agent` mode, contradicting this PR’s new behavior. |

## Progress
- Existing PR discussion already addressed the “is this too complicated?” question and the workflow dispatched this review round.
- Rubrics review passed, including delegated-route authorization, idempotent stop comments, and broad docs coverage.
- Existing inline review comments were empty before synthesis; I posted one new inline comment on `.agent/src/handoff.ts` line 566 for the blocking context issue.
- No replies were added and no existing comments were minimized.
- One reviewer judged the PR shippable with only optional naming/test-readability nits; those are not included as required action items.

## Issue Details
<details>
<summary>Planner-selected PR fix-pr can fall back to wrong task context</summary>

**Cause:** The new PR planner block accepts `next_action: "fix-pr"` and forwards `handoffContext: plannerDecision.handoffContext` without requiring it: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/ed0df2bee677790c90a0dbedb9759981faa922ff/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L558-L567. If it is empty, the CLI later applies `fallbackFixPrHandoffContext()`, which returns the manual `CHANGES_REQUESTED` PR text for any `orchestrate` + `pull_request`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/ed0df2bee677790c90a0dbedb9759981faa922ff/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L884-L890.

**Candidate solutions:** Require non-empty `handoff_context` for planner-selected PR `fix-pr`, or derive a task-specific context from the planner reason/request instead of using the manual requested-change fallback. Add a regression where agent-mode PR orchestration selects `fix-pr` with no context on an approved PR.

**Comments:** This is blocking because `agent-fix-pr` treats `ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT` as the selected task, so the fallback can steer branch-changing automation toward unrelated requested-change review comments.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Technical docs still say PR agent starts are deterministic</summary>

**Cause:** The updated doc explains planner-backed PR starts earlier, but a later paragraph still says “Manual pull request starts remain deterministic in `agent` mode” and only mentions issue-level manual starts invoking the planner: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/ed0df2bee677790c90a0dbedb9759981faa922ff/.agent/docs/technical-details/agent-orchestrator.md#L149-L152.

**Candidate solutions:** Update that paragraph to say PR starts are deterministic only in `heuristics` mode, while `agent` mode can invoke the planner for issue and PR manual starts.

**Comments:** I did not post an inline comment for this because the stale sentence is outside the changed diff hunk, but it is still required docs cleanup for the behavior change.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: The remaining issues are concrete branch changes, and the blocking fix plus docs cleanup are safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
NEEDS_REWORK

## Action Items
- [ ] Require or derive task-specific context for planner-selected PR `fix-pr` handoffs, and add a missing-context regression.
- [ ] Update the stale technical-doc paragraph that still says manual PR starts are deterministic in `agent` mode.

Specifically, prevent planner-selected PR `fix-pr` from falling back to the generic manual `CHANGES_REQUESTED` PR context when `handoff_context` is empty; either require non-empty planner context or derive task-specific context from the planner decision/request.
- Add a regression where agent-mode PR orchestration selects `fix-pr` with no context on an approved PR, proving it does not dispatch with unrelated requested-change fallback context.
- Update the stale paragraph in `.agent/docs/technical-details/agent-orchestrator.md` that still says manual PR starts are deterministic in `agent` mode; it should say PR starts are deterministic only in `heuristics` mode, while `agent` mode can invoke the planner for issue and PR manual starts.
